title: Why the Sky Is Actually Blue
hook: Ever wonder why the sky isn't purple?

script.narration: Ever wonder why the sky isn't purple?

Sunlight looks white, but it is made of all colors of the rainbow. As light hits Earth's atmosphere, gases scatter the blue light in every direction because it travels in smaller waves. Violet light scatters even more, but human eyes are far more sensitive to blue. Did you know this? Comment yes or no.
That is why you are looking up at a blue sky, which makes you ask...
